content: {"instruction": "Reach the goal beyond the three-box tower.", "goal": {"type": "pose", "radius": 0.12, "heading_tolerance": 0.15}, "goal_access": "Call api.get_task_goal() for this episode. It returns a fresh dict with pose=[x,y,yaw], type, radius and heading_tolerance; push goals also have target. Behind-box goals follow the box; re-query after it moves. Stop inside the goal radius with the specified yaw. For gap goals cross between left_box and right_box. For dock goals keep the front 10\u201325 cm from the rack. For push goals place the named box inside the zone; contact with that box is required."}
